caption: A phone set to vibrate buzzes on a wooden table and creeps slowly across the surface.

sa.check: A phone lies on a wooden table.
The phone visibly buzzes: it shivers in place.
It moves across the table surface.
The motion is slow creeping in small jerks, not one glide.
The shivering is under way when the creeping starts; the phone does not move first and buzz later.

pc.expect: The phone moves only while it visibly shivers; if the shiver stops, the phone stops at once and stays where it is.
pc.fail: The phone slides while lying perfectly still; or keeps gliding after the shiver has visibly stopped; or starts moving again with no buzz.

pc.expect: The creep is a series of small jerks in a roughly consistent direction, possibly with slow rotation; the phone stays flat on the table.
pc.fail: The phone shoots across the table in one smooth glide; or zigzags with large reversals; or stands up on an edge; or flips over.

pc.expect: The phone stays on the table surface throughout; if it reaches the edge it tips and falls.
pc.fail: The phone hovers above the table; or hangs over the edge unsupported well past its middle; or climbs onto an object.

pc.expect: The table is rigid and the phone a rigid slab.
pc.fail: The table surface ripples like water; or the phone flexes like rubber; or the phone leaves a trail carved in the wood.

pc.expect: One phone; it does not pass through the table, duplicate or vanish.
pc.fail: The phone duplicates or vanishes; or passes into the table; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The phone's case, screen state and the table grain stay the same.
pc.fail: The phone changes colour; or the screen content changes at random; or the table grain shifts.

note: The caption does not require the buzzing to stop. A clip in which it never stops passes every SA item; if it does stop, the last two fail clauses of P1 apply to what follows.
